detours.why: OSM maps no footway through the Southside Commons block (Aston, Dunn, Krueger and Mosher joined round the Commons, whose only mapped access is on Lubbock Street), and its sidewalks stop short of Mosher Lane without joining, so walks from Aston and Eppright go south and round by Lubbock Street.
Mosher Lane dead-ends in OSM about 15 m short of the path to the Southside Rec Center, so walks from Aston and Eppright go round the Commons block by Lubbock Street and Spence Street to reach it.

Cater-Mattil Hall is across Wellborn Road and the railroad from Northside, crossed only at the Old Main Drive underpass to the south, so walks from Keathley and Moses go down to it and back up Olsen Boulevard.
